# Crossroads third-party notices

<!-- inputs-sha256: 10bd97cbb451dc3526e4ed860c41c9b5c22c8523e2cb20de40aae993e363a4a0 -->

<!-- rustc: rustc 1.99.0 (b940084d7 2026-09-28) -->

Targets: x86\_64-unknown-linux-gnu, x86\_64-pc-windows-msvc. Union of active normal + build graphs: 81 unique registry package versions. This is a conservative inventory, including build-only and proc-macro dependencies, not a claim that all packages are linked into the executable. Dev-only and inactive target dependencies outside this union are excluded.

Source: exact Cargo.lock versions, cached crates.io package manifests and all packaged license, copyright, NOTICE and attribution files. Texts below are reproduced without modification in verbatim fenced blocks. License expressions describe upstream terms, not license selections. Project MIT terms are delivered separately in LICENSE.

Regenerate with python3 scripts/third-party-notices.py --write; review dependency and toolchain changes before distribution.

# System startup and runtime provenance

Conservative inventory of two reviewed builders, in stable order. Only one profile must match the current builder's installed candidates and full notice/license bytes. Neither profile proves actual code contributions: reconcile the matching raw link map and final ELF before distribution. GCC candidates may differ from actual driver flags. Shared libraries are not bundled. Package-wide records include unrelated architectures/languages; inclusion does not make all their licenses apply.

GCC records cover libgcc and crtstuff.c under GPL-3.0-or-later with GCC Runtime Library Exception 3.1, for eligible compilation processes. The glibc exceptions cover only the eight named sources at each exact source version, not other glibc sources or arbitrary GPL code.

```
selected source headers. This is a path-level patch review, not a glibc rebuild
or a claim that the entire patch series was executed in this checkout.

These file-specific exceptions cover the compiled forms of the named sources,
not arbitrary glibc source or other glibc versions. The four installed
```

### /usr/share/doc/gcc-15-base/copyright

```
This is the Debian GNU/Linux prepackaged version of the GNU compiler
collection, containing Ada, C, C++, D, Fortran 95, Go, Objective-C,
Objective-C++, and Modula-2 compilers, documentation, and support
libraries.  In addition, Debian provides the gm2 compiler, either in
the same source package, or built from a separate same source package.
Packaging is done by the Debian GCC Maintainers
<debian-gcc@lists.debian.org>, with sources obtained from:

  ftp://gcc.gnu.org/pub/gcc/releases/            (for full releases)
  https://gcc.gnu.org/git/gitweb.cgi?p=gcc.git   (for prereleases)
  ftp://sourceware.org/pub/newlib/               (for newlib)

The current gcc-15 source package is taken from the git gcc-15-branch.

Changes: See changelog.Debian.gz

Debian splits the GNU Compiler Collection into packages for each language,
library, and documentation as follows:

Language       Compiler package  Library package    Documentation
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
Ada            gnat-15          libgnat-15          gnat-15-doc
Algol-68       ga68-15          libga68-1          libga68-15-doc
C              gcc-15                              gcc-15-doc
C++            g++-15           libstdc++6         libstdc++6-15-doc
COBOL          gcobol-15        libgcobol1
D              gdc-15           libgphobos6
Fortran 95     gfortran-15      libgfortran5       gfortran-15-doc
Go             gccgo-15         libgo0
Objective C    gobjc-15         libobjc4
Objective C++  gobjc++-15
Modula-2       gm2-15           libgm2             libgm2-15-doc
Rust           gccrs-15

For some language run-time libraries, Debian provides source files,
development files, debugging symbols and libraries containing position-
independent code in separate packages:

Language  Sources      Development   Debugging            Position-Independent
------------------------------------------------------------------------------
C++                                  libstdc++6-15-dbg  libstdc++6-15-pic
D         libphobos-15-dev

Additional packages include:

All languages:
libgcc1, libgcc2, libgcc4       GCC intrinsics (platform-dependent)
gcc-15-base                    Base files common to all compilers
gcc-15-soft-float              Software floating point (ARM only)
gcc-15-source                  The sources with patches

Ada:
libgnat-util15-dev, libgnat-util15   GNAT version library

C:
cpp-15, cpp-15-doc            GNU C Preprocessor
libssp0-dev, libssp0            GCC stack smashing protection library
libquadmath0                    Math routines for the __float128 type
fixincludes                     Fix non-ANSI header files

C, C++ and Fortran 95:
libgomp1-dev, libgomp1		GCC OpenMP (GOMP) support library
libitm1-dev, libitm1		GNU Transactional Memory Library

Biarch support: On some 64-bit platforms which can also run 32-bit code,
Debian provides additional packages containing 32-bit versions of some
libraries.  These packages have names beginning with 'lib32' instead of
'lib', for example lib32stdc++6.  Similarly, on some 32-bit platforms which
can also run 64-bit code, Debian provides additional packages with names
beginning with 'lib64' instead of 'lib'.  These packages contain 64-bit
versions of the libraries.  (At this time, not all platforms and not all
libraries support biarch.)  The license terms for these lib32 or lib64
packages are identical to the ones for the lib packages.

0. Definitions.
```

```
This is the Debian GNU/Linux prepackaged version of the GNU compiler
collection, containing Ada, C, C++, D, Fortran 95, Go, Objective-C,
Objective-C++, and Modula-2 compilers, documentation, and support
libraries.  In addition, Debian provides the gm2 compiler, either in
the same source package, or built from a separate same source package.
Packaging is done by the Debian GCC Maintainers
<debian-gcc@lists.debian.org>, with sources obtained from:

  ftp://gcc.gnu.org/pub/gcc/releases/            (for full releases)
  https://gcc.gnu.org/git/gitweb.cgi?p=gcc.git   (for prereleases)
  ftp://sourceware.org/pub/newlib/               (for newlib)

The current gcc-16 source package is taken from the git gcc-16-branch.

Changes: See changelog.Debian.gz

Debian splits the GNU Compiler Collection into packages for each language,
library, and documentation as follows:

Language       Compiler package  Library package    Documentation
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
Ada            gnat-16          libgnat-16          gnat-16-doc
Algol-68       ga68-16          libga68-1          libga68-16-doc
C              gcc-16                              gcc-16-doc
C++            g++-16           libstdc++6         libstdc++6-16-doc
COBOL          gcobol-16        libgcobol1
D              gdc-16           libgphobos6
Fortran 95     gfortran-16      libgfortran5       gfortran-16-doc
Go             gccgo-16         libgo0
Objective C    gobjc-16         libobjc4
Objective C++  gobjc++-16
Modula-2       gm2-16           libgm2             libgm2-16-doc
Rust           gccrs-16

For some language run-time libraries, Debian provides source files,
development files, debugging symbols and libraries containing position-
independent code in separate packages:

Language  Sources      Development   Debugging            Position-Independent
------------------------------------------------------------------------------
C++                                  libstdc++6-16-dbg  libstdc++6-16-pic
D         libphobos-16-dev

Additional packages include:

All languages:
libgcc1, libgcc2, libgcc4       GCC intrinsics (platform-dependent)
gcc-16-base                    Base files common to all compilers
gcc-16-soft-float              Software floating point (ARM only)
gcc-16-source                  The sources with patches

Ada:
libgnat-util16-dev, libgnat-util16   GNAT version library

C:
cpp-16, cpp-16-doc            GNU C Preprocessor
libssp0-dev, libssp0            GCC stack smashing protection library
libquadmath0                    Math routines for the __float128 type
fixincludes                     Fix non-ANSI header files

C, C++ and Fortran 95:
libgomp1-dev, libgomp1		GCC OpenMP (GOMP) support library
libitm1-dev, libitm1		GNU Transactional Memory Library

Biarch support: On some 64-bit platforms which can also run 32-bit code,
Debian provides additional packages containing 32-bit versions of some
libraries.  These packages have names beginning with 'lib32' instead of
'lib', for example lib32stdc++6.  Similarly, on some 32-bit platforms which
can also run 64-bit code, Debian provides additional packages with names
beginning with 'lib64' instead of 'lib'.  These packages contain 64-bit
versions of the libraries.  (At this time, not all platforms and not all
libraries support biarch.)  The license terms for these lib32 or lib64
packages are identical to the ones for the lib packages.

    in a product, an acknowledgment in the product documentation would be
    appreciated but is not required.

    distribution.

By plainly marking modifications, something along the lines of adding to each
file that has been changed a "Modified by Foo Bar" line
underneath the "Written by" line would be adequate.
```

```
DSC signature could not be verified: the installed Ubuntu archive keyring
does not contain signer 50C4A0DDCF31E452CEB19B516569D855A744BE93.
HTTPS primary archive retrieval and matching DSC hashes
establish retrieval/checksum provenance, not an independent source signature.
Source SHA256 values below cover complete patched files; the full leading
copyright/license comments are reproduced verbatim.

Scope
=====
Exceptions apply only to the eight named sources at this source version.
ar t on the verified libc6-dev package payload lists exactly these four
libc_nonshared.a members: at_quick_exit.oS, atexit.oS, pthread_atfork.oS,
stack_chk_fail_local.oS. Their corresponding headers are included below.
They do not establish actual code contributions. Reconcile the matching
final link map and ELF manually before distribution. No universal glibc
exception or source/relinking offer is asserted.

Two other startup sources do not have the exception:
csu/init.c SHA256: 6f78919dd7783b2634ab76d83663d7908c7ad3c0fafd1ff1cd13c5f4420465fc
csu/static-reloc.c SHA256: cfc2c70b02fbe9da29450361f72baac704990e8cfa05374bc51958b7e7bb82d2
```

### /usr/share/doc/gcc-13-base/copyright

Notice/license file SHA256: 08c6f3dee4c19aa1e57eb7d4ad45829b2e99656313bd07fa0922e2553f500be5

```
This is the Debian GNU/Linux prepackaged version of the GNU compiler
collection, containing Ada, C, C++, D, Fortran 95, Go, Objective-C,
Objective-C++, and Modula-2 compilers, documentation, and support
libraries.  In addition, Debian provides the gm2 compiler, either in
the same source package, or built from a separate same source package.
Packaging is done by the Debian GCC Maintainers
<debian-gcc@lists.debian.org>, with sources obtained from:

  ftp://gcc.gnu.org/pub/gcc/releases/  (for full releases)
  svn://gcc.gnu.org/svn/gcc/           (for prereleases)
  ftp://sourceware.org/pub/newlib/     (for newlib)
  git://git.savannah.gnu.org/gm2.git   (for Modula-2)

The current gcc-13 source package is taken from the git gcc-13-branch.

Changes: See changelog.Debian.gz

Debian splits the GNU Compiler Collection into packages for each language,
library, and documentation as follows:

Language       Compiler package  Library package    Documentation
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
Ada            gnat-13          libgnat-13          gnat-13-doc
C              gcc-13                              gcc-13-doc
C++            g++-13           libstdc++6         libstdc++6-13-doc
D              gdc-13
Fortran 95     gfortran-13      libgfortran5       gfortran-13-doc
Go             gccgo-13         libgo0
Objective C    gobjc-13         libobjc4
Objective C++  gobjc++-13
Modula-2       gm2-13           libgm2

For some language run-time libraries, Debian provides source files,
development files, debugging symbols and libraries containing position-
independent code in separate packages:

Language  Sources      Development   Debugging            Position-Independent
------------------------------------------------------------------------------
C++                                  libstdc++6-13-dbg  libstdc++6-13-pic
D         libphobos-13-dev

Additional packages include:

All languages:
libgcc1, libgcc2, libgcc4       GCC intrinsics (platform-dependent)
gcc-13-base                    Base files common to all compilers
gcc-13-soft-float              Software floating point (ARM only)
gcc-13-source                  The sources with patches

Ada:
libgnat-util13-dev, libgnat-util13   GNAT version library

C:
cpp-13, cpp-13-doc            GNU C Preprocessor
libssp0-dev, libssp0            GCC stack smashing protection library
libquadmath0                    Math routines for the __float128 type
fixincludes                     Fix non-ANSI header files

C, C++ and Fortran 95:
libgomp1-dev, libgomp1		GCC OpenMP (GOMP) support library
libitm1-dev, libitm1		GNU Transactional Memory Library

Biarch support: On some 64-bit platforms which can also run 32-bit code,
Debian provides additional packages containing 32-bit versions of some
libraries.  These packages have names beginning with 'lib32' instead of
'lib', for example lib32stdc++6.  Similarly, on some 32-bit platforms which
can also run 64-bit code, Debian provides additional packages with names
beginning with 'lib64' instead of 'lib'.  These packages contain 64-bit
versions of the libraries.  (At this time, not all platforms and not all
libraries support biarch.)  The license terms for these lib32 or lib64
packages are identical to the ones for the lib packages.
```

### /usr/share/doc/gcc-14-base/copyright

Notice/license file SHA256: 20390f8a6f3b1e4d7cb45dd8652dabb259bbef688cbad839bcdb0b9ba7252f79

```
This is the Debian GNU/Linux prepackaged version of the GNU compiler
collection, containing Ada, C, C++, D, Fortran 95, Go, Objective-C,
Objective-C++, and Modula-2 compilers, documentation, and support
libraries.  In addition, Debian provides the gm2 compiler, either in
the same source package, or built from a separate same source package.
Packaging is done by the Debian GCC Maintainers
<debian-gcc@lists.debian.org>, with sources obtained from:

  ftp://gcc.gnu.org/pub/gcc/releases/  (for full releases)
  svn://gcc.gnu.org/svn/gcc/           (for prereleases)
  ftp://sourceware.org/pub/newlib/     (for newlib)
  git://git.savannah.gnu.org/gm2.git   (for Modula-2)

The current gcc-14 source package is taken from the git gcc-14-branch.

Changes: See changelog.Debian.gz

Debian splits the GNU Compiler Collection into packages for each language,
library, and documentation as follows:

Language       Compiler package  Library package    Documentation
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
Ada            gnat-14          libgnat-14          gnat-14-doc
C              gcc-14                              gcc-14-doc
C++            g++-14           libstdc++6         libstdc++6-14-doc
D              gdc-14
Fortran 95     gfortran-14      libgfortran5       gfortran-14-doc
Go             gccgo-14         libgo0
Objective C    gobjc-14         libobjc4
Objective C++  gobjc++-14
Modula-2       gm2-14           libgm2
Rust           gccrs-14

For some language run-time libraries, Debian provides source files,
development files, debugging symbols and libraries containing position-
independent code in separate packages:

Language  Sources      Development   Debugging            Position-Independent
------------------------------------------------------------------------------
C++                                  libstdc++6-14-dbg  libstdc++6-14-pic
D         libphobos-14-dev

Additional packages include:

All languages:
libgcc1, libgcc2, libgcc4       GCC intrinsics (platform-dependent)
gcc-14-base                    Base files common to all compilers
gcc-14-soft-float              Software floating point (ARM only)
gcc-14-source                  The sources with patches

Ada:
libgnat-util14-dev, libgnat-util14   GNAT version library

C:
cpp-14, cpp-14-doc            GNU C Preprocessor
libssp0-dev, libssp0            GCC stack smashing protection library
libquadmath0                    Math routines for the __float128 type
fixincludes                     Fix non-ANSI header files

C, C++ and Fortran 95:
libgomp1-dev, libgomp1		GCC OpenMP (GOMP) support library
libitm1-dev, libitm1		GNU Transactional Memory Library

Biarch support: On some 64-bit platforms which can also run 32-bit code,
Debian provides additional packages containing 32-bit versions of some
libraries.  These packages have names beginning with 'lib32' instead of
'lib', for example lib32stdc++6.  Similarly, on some 32-bit platforms which
can also run 64-bit code, Debian provides additional packages with names
beginning with 'lib64' instead of 'lib'.  These packages contain 64-bit
versions of the libraries.  (At this time, not all platforms and not all
libraries support biarch.)  The license terms for these lib32 or lib64
packages are identical to the ones for the lib packages.
```
